how.title: From a VIN to a verdict you can act on.
how.lede: No forms to memorise, no account to create. The preview is honest about what we did and did not check.

steps.title: Enter the 17-character VIN
steps.body: It is on the windscreen or the driver’s door post. Paste it with spaces or hyphens and we clean it up. If a character looks wrong we name the exact problem, not just “invalid”.

steps.title: See the free preview first
steps.body: Decoded vehicle, record counts, sources checked and not checked. Nothing is charged and no account is created. If there are no records, you pay nothing.

steps.title: Pay once, read the whole report
steps.body: Approve a mobile money prompt or pay by card. The verdict, three reasons, Ghana import check, odometer history, PDF and QR proof arrive in seconds.

visual.reportReason: Two items to inspect before you buy

report.title: The answer first. The evidence behind it.
report.lede: One screen answers “should I buy this car?”. Everything below exists to let you check that answer yourself.

items.title: Traffic-light verdict
items.body: Clear, Caution, High risk or Unknown, with the three reasons that produced it. Colour never carries the meaning alone.

items.title: Ghana import check
items.body: Age, mileage and rule-set checks with the version and date printed, so you know what the advice rests on.

items.title: Odometer history
items.body: A chart of every reading with the drop highlighted, plus a table version for screen readers and print.

items.title: Named sources
items.body: What we checked, what returned nothing and what is not covered. A missing record never reads as a clean car.

items.title: PDF with QR proof
items.body: Vector PDF under 500 KB, plus a public verification page that shows no personal data to whoever scans it.

items.title: Delivered three ways
items.body: On screen, by SMS link and by email, with the report ID you can quote to support.

pricing.title: One price per car. No subscription.
pricing.lede: You pay for a report you can read, keep and prove. Bundles are for buyers comparing more than one car.
pricing.note: Prices include VAT. If no records are found, you are not charged.

plans.name: Single report
features: PDF, QR proof and SMS link

pricing.compare: Carfax reports start around USD 40. Different sources; check what each one covers before you compare.

items.q: What happens if no records are found?
items.a: You are not charged. You get the free preview with official tools to try next. A missing record does not prove a clean history, and we will not pretend that it does.

items.q: Where does the history come from?
items.a: US records through our provider, with the source named and dated on every report. Japan, Europe and the UAE are not covered yet, and the report says so instead of staying silent.
No. We check records, not the physical car. The Ghana import check shows its rule version and effective date so you can see exactly what the advice is based on.
MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money, or a Visa or Mastercard. You approve on your own phone, and we only charge after the gateway confirms server-to-server.
No. A phone number for delivery is enough. If you want the report again later you can save it to an account afterwards.

items.q: How can someone else check my report is real?
items.a: Every report carries a QR code and an ID. The verification page shows the report ID, VIN, issue date and verdict, and never personal data.

closing.title: Know the car before you pay for it.
closing.lede: A free check takes under a minute. You only pay when there is a report worth reading.
